common.forward_axis: model front faces glTF +Z (Blender -Y on export)
common.godot_note: Godot 4 imports glTF unchanged: model front faces +Z, i.e. Godot MODEL_FRONT (Vector3.MODEL_FRONT = +Z). A Node3D looking along its -Z (look_at) will show its back; rotate 180 deg about Y or use look_at(target, Vector3.UP, true) (use_model_front) to face a target.
common.loop_flags_note: glTF has no loop flag. The provided *.glb.import files set settings/loop_mode=1 (linear loop) for the looping clips; verified in Godot 4.7.2 headless import. Otherwise set loop mode in the Advanced Import dialog or in code.

character.name: Korrith Vael-Dun
design_mapping: broad trapezoidal torso + dorsal ridge of overlapping plates rising above the head line (procedural Korrith_DorsalRidge)
honeycomb keratin lattice on shoulders/forearms/shins (from concept, projected+baked)
forearm plates flare into bucklers (generated mesh)
vestigial eyes (no eye geometry; LeftEye/RightEye bones exist only for SkeletonProfileHumanoid)
Seismic Maul -> one-handed maul prop (right hand)
Keratin Bastion -> braced crouch + hex shell FX
palette: style lock overrides doc amber seams -> gunmetal + #00E5FF cyan / magenta emissive

meshes.Korrith_Body: image-to-3D body (Hunyuan3D-2), decimated 826k->22k tris, skinned (nearest-bone-segment weights, side-restricted, 2x smoothed, max 4 influences)
meshes.Korrith_Shield: procedural hex tower shield, 100% rigid to LeftHand_Prop
meshes.Korrith_Maul: procedural seismic maul, 100% rigid to RightHand_Prop
meshes.Korrith_DorsalRidge: procedural dorsal keratin plates, rigid to Chest/UpperChest
meshes.Korrith_BastionFX: hex-lattice shell, alpha-blend emissive cyan, rigid to FX_Bastion; scale ~0 (0.001) in every clip except keratin_bastion

skeleton.naming: Godot SkeletonProfileHumanoid names (all 56 profile bones present, verified in Godot 4.7.2) + extras
skeleton.rest_pose: A-pose (arms ~35 deg below horizontal). Use Godot retarget "Fix Silhouette" if retargeting T-pose clips.
skeleton.retarget_note: Extra prop/FX bones are not in the humanoid profile; when retargeting clips from other rigs, props follow the hands but FX_Bastion/prop-local tracks are not transferred.

cc0_check: Checked Quaternius Universal Animation Library (CC0, UE-style rig: pelvis/spine_01..). Not used: it has no shield bash / defensive brace / maul clips and would need retargeting onto a non-standard bulky A-pose mesh; all clips are hand-keyed by script. No CC0 meshes used.
pipeline: PC (gregspc, RTX 4070): rembg isnet -> Hunyuan3D-2 turbo shape (octree 448, 8 steps, seeds 1234/777; 1234 chosen) -> raw GLB (~0.8-1.1M tris, untextured)

Box (Blender 4.2.23 LTS headless): normalize scale, remove floaters, decimate to budget, Smart-UV, Cycles CPU bake high->low: front-projected concept color/emissive + procedural gunmetal/hex backfill, tangent normal from high-poly + bump
Procedural props (shield, maul, dorsal ridge, Bastion FX, boss Core cage) with bevels/insets/emissive trims, baked to their own atlases
Script-built skeletons, nearest-bone weights, scripted keyframes (boss legs IK-baked), glTF export (KHR_materials_emissive_strength)
Validation: Khronos gltf-validator 2.x (npm), Blender re-import, Godot 4.7.2 headless import
